answer: Bind each new agent to a scarce, non-transferable anchor priced like a saffron harvest: costly per unit and impossible to forge in bulk. Fresh nodes begin on an onyx-dark slate with zero weight and earn trust only through slowly maturing, peer-audited work. Reward flows along a grove of mutually attested edges, and every endorsement spends a non-refundable credit that regenerates slowly. A sybil farm must fund a distinct anchor and age each clone through the whole grove, so cost climbs linearly per head while an honest agent pays the anchor just once.
